checks.description: Every forward prediction must have a non-empty prediction_id.
prediction_id must be unique across forward_predictions.
At most one canonical (is_duplicate_run=False) snapshot per (symbol, observation_date, nse_session).
Canonical snapshots across sessions should not target the same (symbol, entry_date) without deduplication.
Every prediction must record a non-empty model_version.
Every prediction must record a non-empty feature_set_version.
Every prediction must have a valid ISO prediction_timestamp.
observation_date must be a valid NSE trading day.
Canonical prospective predictions must be generated strictly before entry open (09:15 IST on next trading day).
Horizons marked available in model_availability must have non-null probabilities.
All model and benchmark probabilities must lie in [0.0, 1.0].
1D classification counts: total=55, canonical=20, prospective=10 (matured=5, pending=5), historical=5, invalid=5, duplicate=35.

checks.description: Every prediction_log row must have a non-empty prediction_id.
prediction_id must be unique in prediction_log.
prediction_log contains repeated runs for the same (symbol, observation_date) counted independently by monitoring.
prediction_log mixes multiple model_version cohorts in a single rolling metric.

prediction_log uses close[t]->close[t+1] returns, which differs from forward_outcomes open[t+1]->close[t+H].

checks.description: Every outcome must reference an existing prediction_id in forward_predictions.
Every canonical prediction should have 1D, 5D, and 10D rows in forward_outcomes.
(prediction_id, horizon) must be unique in forward_outcomes.
MATURED outcomes must have at least H future NSE trading sessions in equities_daily.
MATURED outcomes must have positive entry_price and exit_price.
entry_date must equal first trading day after obs_date and exit_date must equal entry + (H-1) sessions.
MATURED entry_price/exit_price must match equities_daily open/close.
Previously MATURED outcomes must remain immutable relative to reference snapshot.
MATURED outcomes should have a populated benchmark_return_pct.
gross_return_pct and net_return_pct must match price ratio and transaction cost arithmetic.
INVALID or UNAVAILABLE outcomes must include a non-empty status_reason.
PENDING outcomes whose target exit session is already in equities_daily should be evaluated.

warnings: [OUT_BENCHMARK_MISSING] (WARNING) MATURED outcomes should have a populated benchmark_return_pct. [affected=45]

checks.description: All structured news events must have a valid publication_timestamp.
All structured news events should record a collection_timestamp.
collection_timestamp must not precede publication_timestamp by more than 5 minutes.
publication_timestamp must not be in the future relative to audit time.
Every news event must be attributed to a non-empty ticker.
News events must not match false-positive entity patterns or other-company aliases.
event_id must be unique in structured_events.
Repeated (ticker, source_url) rows should be flagged is_duplicate_report=True.
sentiment must be one of {positive, negative, neutral}.
classification_confidence, novelty_score, and source_credibility must lie in [0, 1].
Quarantined (ticker, url) items must not appear in structured_events or published timelines.
Published timeline events with collection_timestamp > latest_prediction_at (<= 15 min; pipeline timestamp ordering).
Published timeline events with collection_timestamp > latest_prediction_at by > 15 minutes.
Events collected after snapshot timestamp should not carry effective_trading_date <= snapshot observation_date.
